verdict.rationale: Aleph is an FP&A SaaS platform, so a documented public API is a fair question for it. The pack only shows no-code connectors, spreadsheet add-ins and a Slack-tagged agent. The line "plus anything with an API" is about pulling data in from other systems' APIs, not Aleph's own API, and probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
